name: Voxtype
author: Guilherme Yamakawa de Oliveira
description: Show and edit the voxtype dictation polish pipeline from a native bar panel: an ordered list of sed, local-LLM and cloud stages, each of which can be marked as a fallback that only runs when the step above it fails. Includes a dictation-history window.

barWidget.description: Shows the active polish pipeline in the bar; click for a native editor that reorders, adds, removes and toggles fallback on stages, and opens the dictation history.

schema.label: Tint the bar icon per mode
